Definitions (standardized)
Intensity (0–6): your original scale → perceived severity
Opacity (α): 0.0–1.0 (how visible the ghost is)
Position (%): vertical offset of ghost relative to source text
Top: ghost above text (e.g., +80%)
Bottom: ghost below text (e.g., −30%)
Mode:
Single: one ghost (top or bottom)
Dual: both top and bottom ghosts present

Rules you observed

Typical α ≈ 0.2–0.3
Severe α ≈ 0.7–0.8
Bottom ghosts: α ≥ 0.5
Worst case: dual (top + bottom)
